name: Unyielding Stance (Combat, Ki)
body:
Your strength of spirit and will makes it hard for others to move you against your wishes.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you gain a +2 bonus to your CMD against bull rush, drag, and reposition maneuvers and to saving throws against any effect that would push, pull, or otherwise physically move you from your position. This does not apply against teleportation effects.

In addition, when you are targeted with such an effect you can spend 1 point from your ki pool as a free action to add your Wisdom bonus to your CMD or saving throw. This stacks with the above bonus.
